title: Pick, Wash, Pack the Fruit Picnic | Orchard Song for Kids
format: orchard-to-picnic action story-song with permission, counting and colour patterns

music.sound_policy: Leaves, fruit, basket, water and packing sounds are synchronized effects and never spoken as imitation words.

creative_intent: Follow one basket from orchard permission to a shared picnic, making gentle picking, washing, counting, colour patterns and avoiding waste feel like one joyful musical cause-and-effect journey.
visual_system: premium luminous layered watercolour-and-gouache storybook orchard panels with translucent painted-paper depth, hand-inked edges and sunlit colour

motion_language.easing_family: soft cubic ease with tiny fruit-weight settle
motion_language.transition_family: match cuts through round fruit, basket handles and flowing water arcs
motion_language.motion_intensity: one hero action per scene; support below half amplitude; leaves and light drift only
motion_language.hold_discipline: one full beat of rest after each pick, count, wash or placement

character_lock.kai: Kai, six-year-old East Asian-Australian boy, short black hair, burnt-orange sunhat, sky-blue overalls over a lemon-yellow shirt, red canvas shoes
character_lock.orchard_keeper: Rosa, warm older orchard keeper with silver-streaked dark braid, olive-green shirt, plum apron and woven straw hat
character_lock.orchard: sunlit mixed orchard with red apples, golden pears, purple plums, painted wooden gate, blue enamel wash station and red-gold-purple picnic blanket

scenes.visual_action: At the painted orchard gate, Kai holds one empty woven basket and asks Rosa before entering. Rosa opens the gate and points to the ripe-fruit row; unripe green fruit remains clearly untouched.
lyrics: Morning paints the orchard, red and gold and blue,
Kai brings one empty basket; what should Kai do?
Ask before we enter, wait to hear what's right,
Rosa opens up the gate: the ripe row is in sight.
scenes.camera: curved push from empty basket through the opening gate

scenes.visual_action: Kai supports a low apple branch with one hand, twists one ripe red apple with the other and lowers it carefully into the basket without tugging leaves or unripe fruit.
lyrics: Hold the branch so gently; choose one apple red,
Lift and make a little turn, just as Rosa said.
Lower to the basket; keep the fruit from harm,
One careful apple settles softly on Kai's arm.
scenes.camera: close side arc linking supported branch, hands and basket

scenes.visual_action: On a low orchard table, Kai and Rosa count exactly six fruits into one basket: two red apples, two golden pears and two purple plums. Three matching picture tokens prove the pairs.
lyrics: Two red apples, count them one and two,
Two gold pears are joining, then two plums in blue.
Pairs make six together, colours bright and neat,
Basket bends a little with our orchard treat.
scenes.camera: stable overhead count tableau, then tilt to the weighted handle

scenes.visual_action: At the blue enamel wash station, clean water flows over all six fruits while Kai turns them in a shallow colander and Rosa closes the tap when the last fruit is clean.
lyrics: Water over apples, pears and purple plums,
Turn each piece so every side can meet the stream that comes.
Clean and bright, the six fruits shine,
Rosa stops the water right on time.
scenes.camera: low water-level follow ending on Rosa's hand at the closed tap

scenes.visual_action: Kai dries and packs the whole fruit into a divided picnic box in a repeating red-gold-purple, red-gold-purple pattern. Rosa checks that bruised fruit is placed safely on top rather than wasted.
lyrics: Red, then gold, then purple in a row,
Red, then gold, then purple—watch the pattern grow.
Soft fruit rides on top where nothing gets a squeeze,
Close the picnic box with gentle hands, please.
scenes.camera: top-down pattern reveal followed by one eased box-close tilt

scenes.visual_action: The packed basket is visibly heavy. Kai and Rosa each take one handle and carry it together along the orchard path toward the red-gold-purple picnic blanket without spilling fruit.
lyrics: Heavy basket, steady feet,
Kai and Rosa share the weight and match the walking beat.
Handle level, pathway clear,
Picnic colours wait for us; we're nearly here.
scenes.camera: low travelling follow matching the level basket

scenes.visual_action: Kai and Rosa sit at the orchard-edge picnic. The six clean fruits and repeating colour pattern remain visible; they each choose one fruit, share the remaining basket and place one leaf in a small compost bowl.
lyrics: Ask and pick, then wash and pack,
Carry it together down the orchard track.
Share the colours, waste no bite,
Fruit-picnic friends make the whole day bright.
scenes.camera: slow pullback from six-fruit pattern to the complete orchard picnic

quality_gates: Kai, Rosa, their clothes, basket, orchard and colour palette remain consistent.
Kai asks permission before picking and unripe fruit remains untouched.
The count scene visibly contains exactly two apples, two pears and two plums.
The wash scene keeps all six fruits visible and the tap visibly closes.
The pack scene shows a red-gold-purple pattern repeated exactly twice.
Every lyric and effect remains inside the matching visual scene.
No fruit, water, step, latch or basket sound is spoken as imitation.
Every story scene is five four-beat bars (13.333333 seconds) and below 14 seconds.
Final output includes full decode, visual, transition, count, pattern and lyric-emotion-sync evidence.
